title: Is Ringless Voicemail Legal? Only With Consent. It Is a Call
meta_description: The FCC ruled in November 2022 that ringless voicemail is a call. A drop costs 3.5 to 12 cents; one sent without consent can cost $500 in damages per violation.
secondary_keywords: is ringless voicemail legal in florida

image.takeaway: Ringless voicemail is a call under the TCPA. A marketing drop needs written consent and a toll-free opt-out.
image.alt: Is ringless voicemail legal: the FCC ruled in November 2022 that a ringless voicemail is a call made with a prerecorded voice, so each drop needs consent; under the FCC’s rules a marketing drop needs written consent and a toll-free opt-out line
